title: Adobe Connect is affected by an Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')…
description: Adobe Connect suffers from a path traversal vulnerability that allows a low-privileged attacker to execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the current user. This vulnerability does not require user interaction and can lead to elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. The vulnerability changes the security scope and has a high impact on confidentiality and integrity.
